name: Darius Crowley
summary: Lord Darius Crowley is a fiery Gilnean nobleman who staunchly championed the Grand Alliance and opposed King Genn Greymane's isolationist policy. After the construction of the Greymane Wall severed his northern holdings and abandoned the outside world, Crowley led the Northgate Rebellion, an armed revolt that ultimately landed him in Stoneward Prison for high treason.

sections.title: A Friend of the Alliance
sections.body: During the Second War, Lord Darius Crowley was one of Gilneas's most charismatic and popular young nobles. When King Genn Greymane journeyed to Lordaeron to hear Anduin Lothar speak on Stormwind's destruction, Crowley urged his monarch to aid their fellow human nations against the Old Horde. His sympathy for the Alliance never wavered, even as Greymane grew resentful of the internment camp expenses and taxes required to rebuild the south. When the Third War broke out and Greymane chose seclusion, Crowley defied royal orders by dispatching the Gilneas Brigade across the Great Sea alongside Lady Jaina Proudmoore's expedition to Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Northgate Rebellion
sections.body: King Greymane's decision to construct the massive Greymane Wall cut straight through Crowley's ancestral lands, abandoning holdings like Ambermill and Pyrewood Village to the wilderness beyond. Viewing the wall as both an insult and an act of tyrannical cowardice, Crowley raised an armed faction known as the Northgate rebels to depose the king. The ensuing civil war tore through Gilneas until the rebels made an assault on Gilneas City itself, bombarding the capital with artillery. Royalist forces rallied and shattered the insurrection, and Crowley was captured and locked away in Stoneward Prison, branded a traitor.

faq.answer: Lord Darius Crowley is a prominent Gilnean lord who fiercely advocated for Gilneas to remain part of the Grand Alliance. He opposed King Genn Greymane's isolationism, funded an expedition to Kalimdor against the king's wishes, and eventually led an armed civil war to overthrow the crown.

faq.q: Where is Darius Crowley right now?
faq.answer: Crowley is imprisoned deep within Stoneward Prison in Gilneas City. Following the defeat of his rebel forces in the Northgate Rebellion, the Gilnean crown convicted him of high treason and had him placed under heavy lock and key.

faq.q: Why did Crowley rebel against King Greymane?
faq.answer: Crowley opposed Greymane's decision to withdraw Gilneas from the Alliance and erect the Greymane Wall. The construction cut right through Crowley's northern holdings, stranding settlements such as Ambermill and Pyrewood outside the kingdom's protection. Viewing this as tyrannical abandonment, Crowley took up arms.

faq.q: What lands did Crowley hold outside the Greymane Wall?
faq.answer: Before the Greymane Wall sealed Gilneas off from Silverpine Forest, Crowley owned and administered the settlements of Ambermill and Pyrewood Village, along with the surrounding territory in the north.

angles.text: Crowley remained one of the few Gilnean nobles committed to the Grand Alliance, defying his king to send troops with Jaina Proudmoore to Kalimdor.
For humans outside the closed gates of the Greymane Wall, Crowley is remembered as a rare Gilnean leader who refused to abandon his neighbors during the dark days of the Third War.
